say:1:1122116001:1.text: Oho! Is this the little terrabird you've brought for me? Lemme take a good look!
say:1:1122116001:1.source_cn: 嗬，这就是你抓回来的小陆行鸟？让我仔细瞧瞧！

say:2:1122116002:1.text: Hmm. Big bright eyes, glossy feathers, healthy legs... Ouch! This little one scratched my arm! It's a strong little fella.
say:2:1122116002:1.source_cn: 嗯，眼睛又大又亮，羽毛也油光水滑的，这腿更是——嘶，这...

say:3:1122116003:1.text: Not bad at all! This one's gonna be a great partner, I'm pleased.
say:3:1122116003:1.source_cn: 不错，不错！它以后肯定会成为我的好伙伴！我很满意！
